welcomeMessage1: A board game night always ends with a last round, but it starts well before that.
welcomeMessage2: Our objective is to make players want to discover your new game, to make yourself known as a designer, and to promote publishers who love the world of board games.
welcomeMessage3: By presenting your game’s illustrations, the beauty of the components, and mechanics we encounter during a game, our photos and videos will help your projects reach the next level.
welcomeMessage4: We are looking forward to discovering your games and doing business with you.
